pattādhāraka.cp: masc. a stand for a bowl.
pattādhāraka.p:
[Patta+ādhāraka] (pu,na) CL=8 The bottom of the monk's bowl, Karvakakhve which is to keep monk's bowl in place.
( Karvakakhve means circular frame made of intertwined rattan or bamboo (especially to keep round bottomed pots in place)).
